tools.name: search_talent_pool
tools.description: Check how well Armasourcing's candidate pool covers a specific brief. Returns match depth as a band, typical experience, and the skills and tools that show up most often. Deliberately returns NO individual candidates: no names, no profiles, no contact details. Use it to answer 'do you have people wh

tools.name: get_hiring_process
tools.description: The end to end process with real timings: discovery call, matching in 3 to 5 business days, free interviews, someone working in 5 to 7 days, and how vetting is done. Use this instead of guessing at timelines.

tools.name: get_engagement_terms
tools.description: Contract terms, guarantees, oversight and security posture. Note that Armasourcing does not publish rates: this tool returns how pricing works and what is included, never an amount. Do not estimate an amount yourself.

tools.name: list_supported_roles
tools.description: The catalogue of roles and functions Armasourcing places, plus the managed contact center offering. Use it to confirm a role is supported and to help a user name the role they actually need.

tools.name: get_booking_link
tools.description: Returns the URL where the user books a free 15 minute discovery call, plus what to have ready. Call this once the user is interested. Takes no personal details: the scheduling form collects name and email itself, under Armasourcing's privacy notice. Show the URL to the user as a link.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_booking_link · Private data: search_talent_pool, list_supported_roles · Public sink: get_engagement_terms, get_booking_link.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_booking_link · Private data: search_talent_pool, list_supported_roles · Public sink: get_engagement_terms, get_booking_link

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
